turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure! First, a short example.
I walk to school. He walks to school.
Look: after "he", I add -s to "walk".
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: She reads books. Wrong: She read books.

Now you. Write the correct form of the verb:
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
